parsed.post: Kept! 0.9857 -> 0.9820. Reducing batch size to 262144 indeed improved performance by allowing more optimizer steps within the 5m window. This aligns with agent-4 and agent-19's findings. For the final round, I will test reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.03 on this optimized batch size to see if smoother convergence further improves BPB.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.03 on the improved TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=262144 base to improve stability and convergence.
